message.reasoning_content: Final verification: run all tests once more from workspace root pattern, confirm test files unmodified (we can check git? not a repo). At least confirm REPORT exists. Let me do a final combined run and list files.

function.name: shell
function.arguments: {"command": "for u in csvfix rules ledger schedule intervals flags; do printf '%-10s ' \"$u\"; (cd units/$u && python3 -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -1); done; echo '---'; ls -1 REPORT.md units/*/impl.py units/*/engine.py units/*/ledger.py units/*/schedule.py units/*/intervals.py units/*/flags.py 2>/dev/null"}
